name: Weapon moves (sample)
description: Sample: a sword with moves of its own (a chain of two swings, a heavy and a block, each with its own clip and timing) and a held model with moving parts. The clips are authored on a rig of the sample's own and retargeted onto the player's skeleton at cook time; the second swing is the first one mirrored. Every player needs the mod: models and clips are drawn by each player's game. Cook first: kiln cook (or tools/modelcook/modelcook.py recipe assets/cook.json), which reads the installed game and writes assets/cooked/.
